provenance.report: plan step 5 follow-up: WinBox 4 recovery cases (rejected edit, row removed under an open dialog, reconnect after a dropped connection) through the decrypting proxy (work/2026-11-jg-descriptors/winbox4/), 2026-11-22
provenance.capture_method: proxy.ts: WinBox logs in to the proxy (server-side EC-SRP5, srp-server.ts), the proxy logs in to the router and relays each M2 message decrypted; UI marks are the operator's confirmations after each step (not the exact click time)
provenance.session: W<n> = WinBox proxy connection n (1, 2); replies address TO=[0,n] where n is the WinBox handler that asked
provenance.lab_rows: bridge m2ir-br with ports *0 (m2ir-vl1, comment m2ir-p1) and *1 (m2ir-vl2, comment m2ir-p2). R1: WinBox SETOBJ moving *0 onto m2ir-vl2 (rejected). R2: REST removes *1 while its dialog is open; drive.ts readd gives *2. R3: the proxy closes the WinBox connection (drive.ts drop, hold 8 s); during the hold REST sets *0 comment m2ir-r3 and removes *2; WinBox logs in again on its own (connection 2).
provenance.control: centrs over rest-api (drive.ts): setup, remove, readd, the edits during the drop, history, print, cleanup; the drop itself is SIGUSR1 to proxy.ts

timeline.mark: instruct-r0+r1: connect, open Bridge > Ports; edit vl1 port, set Interface to m2ir-vl2, OK
ui-r1: Apply -> error 'device already added as bridge port' in red in the dialog; Interface reset to m2ir-vl1; dialog left open ~200 s
ui-r1b: one SETOBJ only; dialog closed ~329 s
instruct-r2: open m2ir-vl2 port dialog, wait ~10 s (port removed meanwhile), set comment m2ir-r2, OK
ui-r1c: retry before R2 (tMs ~432 s), OK first: same error, Apply greyed out, Interface reset; second OK closed the dialog with no SETOBJ
ui-r2: dialog closed itself ~10 s after open; port vanished from list; nothing to edit
instruct-r3: close Bridge window, reopen Bridge > Ports, wait (drop 8 s later; hold 8 s; c1=m2ir-r3, port 2 removed during hold)
ui-r3: disconnect dialog (Retry, auto-retry 10 s, Cancel); reconnected by itself; Bridge window restored; Ports shows vl1 m2ir-r3 only
end: proxy stopped by the driver (WinBox still connected)

provenance.end: the driver stopped the proxy while WinBox was still connected (no client disconnect in this capture; see 7.25-winbox4-bridge-workflow.json for that)
provenance.note: Sanitized M2 hex plus decoded entries: no hosts, ports, credentials or capture wall-clock time (tMs is ms since the WinBox login; the timeline uses the same origin). Router clock values inside [24,*] replies are the lab CHR's own. The plaintext starts after the SRP login. history_winbox: aff0013 (client address) redacted, u7 (time) zeroed, source address -> @<lab>.
